Text: Can the child say at least 5 single words clearly?
Can the child name common objects when shown a picture?
Can the child form a 2-word phrase (e.g. "more milk", "go outside")?
Can the child answer a simple question like "What is your name?" or "How old are you?"
Can the child describe what is happening in a picture using a sentence?
Can the child recognize familiar people like parents and siblings?
Can the child match objects by color or shape?
Can the child follow a 2-step instruction (e.g. pick up the ball and put it on the table)?
Can the child count objects up to 10?
Can the child solve a simple problem independently (e.g. figure out how to reach a toy)?
Does the child make eye contact during conversation?
Does the child play alongside other children without conflict?
Can the child take turns in a simple game or activity?
Can the child recognize and name basic emotions (happy, sad, angry) in others?
Can the child initiate a conversation or activity with another child on their own?
Can the child walk up and down stairs?
Can the child kick or throw a ball with direction?
Can the child hold a pencil or crayon and draw a line?
Can the child button or unbutton clothing independently?
Can the child ride a tricycle or balance on one foot for 3 seconds?
